svg.title: GainSec — mission dossier
svg.desc: Mission dossier for GainSec (GainSec): 8 featured projects. Shown: the first project's card fully written (now loading: gainsec; operation:), its 2x4 technology screen with the device at its first frame, and the mission log of every project with the first framed (the animated file plays them all in turn). 1. AutoProber (gainsec/autoprober) — operation a.u.t.o.p.r.o.b.e.r. — "autoprober underground target operator pcb review offensive beyond embedded reverse" (invented words: underground); mission 036; ★ 336 · ⑂ 20 · python · 1 issue; vs. nap enforcement; 2x4 technology: plank plane; lumber: 304 ft (7285 KB). 2. Treehouse Defense System (gainsec/tree-house-defense-system-tds) — operation t.r.e.e.h.o.u.s.e.-d.e.f.e.n.s.e.-s.y.s.t.e.m. — "treehouse rf enemy enormous hosted observations urgently system extremely defense escape frame entirely noodles self emergency steam yoyo size tabletop evil mostly" (invented words: enemy, enormous, urgently, extremely, escape, entirely, noodles, emergency, yoyo, evil, mostly); mission 051; ★ 5 · ⑂ 0 · typescript; pushed within 30 days; 2x4 technology: crate crane; lumber: 2871 ft (68896 KB). 3. BattleReadyArmor — Slim (gainsec/battlereadyarmor-slim) — operation b.a.t.t.l.e.r.e.a.d.y.a.r.m.o.r.-s.l.i.m. — "battlereadyarmor an team totally llm explicit reporting evidence ai depth yoyo augmented red menace operator rooftop slim launcher in mailbox" (invented words: totally, yoyo, menace, rooftop, launcher, mailbox); mission 040; ★ 6 · ⑂ 0 · html; has releases; 2x4 technology: heater rocket; lumber: 7296 ft (175098 KB). 4. AgentReadyArmor — Teaser (gainsec/agentreadyarmor-teaser) — operation a.g.e.n.t.r.e.a.d.y.a.r.m.o.r.-t.e.a.s.e.r. — "agentreadyarmor github evidence numbuh teaser runtime emergency and depth yawning auditable repository mustard operator rooftop testing extremely an substrate enormous rocket" (invented words: numbuh, emergency, yawning, repository, mustard, rooftop, extremely, enormous, rocket); mission 041; ★ 0 · ⑂ 0 · html; 2x4 technology: tub boat; lumber: 3 ft (60 KB). 5. ArcticBase (gainsec/arcticbase) — operation a.r.c.t.i.c.b.a.s.e. — "arcticbase runbooks collaboration task important claude band agent self extremely" (invented words: important, extremely); mission 039; ★ 16 · ⑂ 0 · python; pushed within 30 days; 2x4 technology: heater rocket; lumber: 136 ft (3254 KB). 6. BirdShot (gainsec/birdshot) — operation b.i.r.d.s.h.o.t. — "birdshot immediately research dodging safety hopefully offline testing" (invented words: immediately, dodging, hopefully); mission 046; ★ 42 · ⑂ 3 · python; 2x4 technology: tub bus; lumber: 162 ft (3898 KB). 7. DWARF (pragma-org/dwarf) — operation d.w.a.r.f. — "dwarf with and runtime fuzzing"; external mission (not one of this profile's repositories: no tokens or callouts); 2x4 technology: tub bus. 8. Super Awesome AI Driver (gainsec/super-awesome-ai-driver) — operation s.u.p.e.r.-a.w.e.s.o.m.e.-a.i.-d.r.i.v.e.r. — "super usually python engineered reverse and way extra sooper or motion extremely awesome intercepted driver rumbling improvised video escape rescue" (invented words: usually, extra, sooper, extremely, intercepted, rumbling, improvised, escape, rescue); mission 048; ★ 2 · ⑂ 1 · python · 1 issue; vs. early curfew squad; 2x4 technology: mower tank; lumber: 225 ft (5392 KB). Devices are junk-built green wireframes with every edge drawn; their callouts read lumber = size ÷ 24 KB in feet, speed = stars in mph, tape = open issues in rolls, crew = forks in kids. End transmission — transmission 2026-10-22, sector g.
